definitions.explanation: An electrical device that uses suction to remove dirt and dust from floors and other surfaces.

notes:
Types of vacuum cleaners:
- ⟦キャニスター→キャニスター：noentry⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (canister type) - traditional with separate body and hose
- ⟦スティック→スティック：noentry⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (stick type) - upright, often cordless
- ⟦ハンディ→ハンディ：noentry⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (handheld) - portable, for small areas
- ⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧{掃除機|そうじき} (robot vacuum) - autonomous cleaning
